name: dina-skills
description: Claude skills by Dina Farhat. Professional-practice skills built for real work rather than demos, each one packaged as a standalone plugin.

plugins.name: business-audit-forensics
plugins.description: Business financial audit and forensic accounting. Internal audit and adversarial investigation, with scripts for evidence custody, reconciliation, roll-forward, and control-checked exception testing.

plugins.name: ai-secure-code-review-guide
plugins.description: AI-led secure code review. Threat model, review, triage and report, with a diff mode for pending changes and an Android and Kotlin rule pack. An instruction guide, not a scanner.

plugins.name: aim-higher
plugins.description: Raises the ceiling on a task before work starts. The four kinds of ambition, speed, altitude, depth and range, with a guardrail separating an unreasonable target from an unreasonable claim, paste-ready prompts by domain, and crews and outside judges that can refuse.

plugins.name: social-media-marketing
plugins.description: Organic social-media strategy and platform-native content. Strategy, calendars, scripts, titles and thumbnails, channel audits and competitor analysis, behind a claim-safety gate that keeps source status and claim status separate and refuses to let a disclaimer carry a headline the evidence does not support.
